svg.title: From a target noise position to the first joint attention update
svg.desc: The marked position becomes one row of the packed target tokens. The image projection and timestep modulation prepare queries, keys and values. For one head, each target query compares against every text, reference and target key in a single softmax. The weights mix the corresponding values. All heads are combined before the gated residual updates the target features. The highlight tracks a position, not a measured attention weight.

g.aria-label: A target spatial position becomes one token
The text tokens and the reference image supply their own keys and values
Joint attention for one target query in one head
Combine all heads and write the gated update to the target stream
